title: Step $$1$$
text: $$E(x)=\frac{(2x)**3}{(4x)**3}$$ is given. There is no error here.

title: Step $$2$$
text: This is a misapplied law of exponents. $$\frac{(2x)**3}{(4x)**3}=\frac{2**3\cdot{x**3}}{4**3\cdot{x**3}}$$ not $$\frac{2**3+x**3}{4**3+x**3}$$

title: Step $$3$$
text: Step $$3$$ expands the first term in the numerator and denominator to express as a number: $$\frac{2**3+x**3}{4**3+x**3}=\frac{8+x**3}{64+x**3}$$
